name: safe-recycle
title_zh: 回收站只清你点过头的文件，临时区自动归位
tagline_zh: 怕误删？它把删除和清理分成两件事：日常移动交给规则，只有你说"清空回收站"才动真格。
tagline_en: Scared of accidental deletion? It splits moving from purging: routine moves follow rules, only an explicit "empty.
desc_en: Workspace sandbox for safe file disposal and purge. Triggers ONLY when: (1) the user says "清空回收站" or "empty recycle bin" (to run purge.py), (2) the user asks about the recycle or temp system, (3) first-time setup of .recycle/._temp/ in a new workspace. Do NOT trigger on routine file moves — the Rule handles day-to-day enforcement.
why_zh: 把"删除"降级为"移入沙盒"，把"清空"升级为"显式命令"。机制上杜绝了脚本误删和手滑。
why_en: Downgrades deletion to sandbox moves, upgrades purging to explicit commands. Mechanically prevents script misfires and slips.
limit_zh: 只认两个动作：用户说"清空回收站"才运行 purge.py，以及首次配置沙盒。日常文件移动由 Rule 负责。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit "empty recycle bin" or first-time sandbox setup. Routine moves are handled by Rule, not this Skill. Existing.
title_en: Purge only what you approve; temp files auto-sorted
